evidence: Modifies headers presync parameter calculation and handling in src/headerssync.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: The PR fixes an attack modeling flaw in headers presync DoS parameters and ensures parameter optimality over time. The previous calculation 'got it (slightly) wrong by missing the fact that attackers are capable of strategically deciding to stop the attack in the middle of a batch', and moving calculation to runtime eliminates static parameter drift and maintainer error during releases.
